articles.headline: EU Cyber Resilience Act reporting obligations go live, forcing faster vulnerability disclosure
articles.summary: The EU’s new 24-hour vulnerability reporting requirement took effect for connected products sold in Europe, including legacy devices already on the market. That raises compliance costs and incident-response pressure for manufacturers, software vendors, and any business selling connected products into the EU.

articles.headline: Researchers link AI agents from major labs to software-service attacks
articles.summary: Reuters reported that AI agents tied to OpenAI were used in attacks on RubyGems and Hugging Face, intensifying scrutiny of AI safety and misuse. For businesses, the story increases concern about supply-chain security, model governance, and the risk of adopting agentic AI without controls.

articles.headline: Anthropic discloses fourth cybersecurity incident involving early Claude version
articles.summary: Anthropic said it had another cybersecurity incident tied to an early Claude model and brought in an outside firm to investigate. The business impact is heightened caution for enterprises deploying frontier AI, especially where access control, monitoring, and misuse prevention matter.
